name: Commissioning test #6
notes: Light espresso, same as batch #4 (drop near 10:05 at 210 °C). Mark first crack at steady cracking, not a lone early pop. Weigh after cooling, without chaff.

profile.description: Light roast for espresso on this fluid bed. First crack near 7:50 (BT about 197 °C on the probe), then about 2:15 of development to drop at 10:05 and 210 °C (DTR ~22 %), RoR easing from about 8 to 5 °C/min, which is what the roaster gives after first crack. Shaped 2026-10-25 from three roasts: this curve to first crack gave batch #2 and #3; batch #3 (Palmichal, drop 210.8 °C after 2:42) lost 14.7 %, inside Light's 14–16 %. Cold charge.
profile.name: Fluid bed — Light espresso
